integrity: Proof, precise hypotheses, comparisons, and finite computational checks are included; finite tests are not presented as an infinite proof. The two primary sources and their contributions are credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite nilpotent index-three semigroups only; the equivalence requires a two-colourable nonzero-product digraph. The four-variable conclusion is an upper bound. The nilpotent semiring-to-duality correspondence is used from a published theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A bipartite product-digraph threshold for full power semirings
